core_questions.question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath, wheezing, or difficulty speaking in complete sentences?
core_questions.safety_implication: Shortness of breath or inability to speak in sentences is an acute red flag.

core_questions.question: Is the cough dry or productive, and have you coughed up any blood or rust-colored phlegm?
core_questions.safety_implication: Hemoptysis (coughing up blood) requires immediate urgent/emergency medical review.

core_questions.question: How long have you had this cough?
core_questions.safety_implication: Chronic cough > 3 weeks requires routine primary care workup.

counterfactuals.condition: If patient develops shortness of breath or lips turn blue
If cough is productive of blood or accompanied by high fever > 3 days
counterfactuals.recommendation_shift: Moves to Urgent Care (Level 2) for chest X-ray / exam

counterfactuals.condition: If cough is mild, dry, without fever or dyspnea and improving within 7 days
